meta.name: grow-website
meta.description: Guided journey from a website with traffic it under-converts to a research-driven growth engine that captures more leads, persuades more buyers, sells a sharper offer, and earns referrals. Orchestrates eight skills phase by phase - cro-methodology, scorecard-marketing, storybrand-messaging, made-to-stick, influence-psychology, hundred-million-offers, contagious, one-page-marketing - asking the user questions at every decision point and recording results in the project docs/ folder (WEBSITE.md, OFFER.md, MARKETING.md, GROW-WEBSITE-PLAN.md) so the journey resumes across sessions. Use when the user wants to raise conversion on a site that already has traffic, capture more leads, sharpen a weak offer, add referral loops, or says 'my site gets visitors but nobody buys'. If a broken funnel or usability friction is the real blocker, run improve-website first; if there is no site yet, use create-website. For one framework in isolation, invoke that skill directly.

copy.tagline: 把有流量的网站变成持续增长的引擎
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果网站有流量但转化率低，想系统提升获客和销售。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a website with traffic into a growth engine that captures more leads and sales.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your site gets visitors but few conversions, and you want a systematic growth process.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会引导你通过八个阶段，将一个已有流量但转化不佳的网站转变为增长引擎。它会询问你的决策，并将结果记录在项目文档中，以便跨会话继续。
howto.when: 当你想提高已有流量网站的转化率、获取更多线索、优化薄弱的产品或添加推荐机制时触发。如果你说“我的网站有访客但没人买”，也会触发。

say.text: 我的网站有流量但没人买，帮我优化。
say.note: Claude 会开始引导你完成八个阶段。

say.text: 我想提高网站的转化率，从哪里开始？
say.note: Claude 会进行初始信息收集并创建计划。

say.text: 帮我分析为什么访客不转化。
say.note: Claude 会进入第一阶段，使用 CRO 方法论。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude guides you through eight phases to turn a website with traffic but low conversion into a growth engine. It asks your decisions and records results in project docs so the journey can resume across sessions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to raise conversion on a site that already has traffic, capture more leads, sharpen a weak offer, or add referral loops. Also triggered if you say 'my site gets visitors but nobody buys'.

say_en.text: My site has traffic but nobody buys, help me optimize.
say_en.note: Claude will start guiding you through the eight phases.

say_en.text: I want to improve my website conversion, where to start?
say_en.note: Claude will run intake and create a plan.

say_en.text: Help me analyze why visitors don't convert.
say_en.note: Claude enters Phase 1 using CRO methodology.
